title: Governed LoRA Factory
valueStatement: Manifest → LoRA → gated MLflow lineage → registry. One trainer.py routes CE to BCE without code change — proved on a 4GB T1000.
architectureHighlight: corpus25_playbook.yaml declares datasets (SST-2, 4-way intent, 16-tag BCE), thresholds (ln4→1.5, BCE 0.693→0.48), and stages; trainer.py stays untouched.
description: An opinionated, manifest-driven micro-CI for AI weights — the governance layer Axolotl/LlamaFactory leave you to stitch by hand. Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct + PEFT LoRA (r=4) trains under MLflow hermes/llm-lora isolation on a 4GB Quadro T1000 (batch2 eff8, seq 64/32/128, BF16), sweeps with Optuna parent/child lineage, and promotes only through assert_promotable gates to rswan-llm-lora. Proven v3 (binary CE 0.5804) and v6 (16-head BCE 0.464/80.5% Hamming) share one Hub repo (TokyoEye/rswan-llm-lora main vs v6-narrative-tags). The same loop that rejects a 24-row 2.68 probe promotes a 200-row 1.44 — no checkpoint-folder guessing.
pitch: The governance Axolotl doesn't give you: gates, lineage, and 4GB guardrails in one declarative loop.
challenge: Solo teams fine-tune with Axolotl/LlamaFactory but still script their own tracking, hand-pick checkpoints, and push broken adapters. They need a mini-CI that fails closed — if val/loss doesn't clear the gate, nothing hits the registry — and that scales from 2-way CE to 16-tag BCE via config, not code forks.
development: Built mlflow-pytorch-trainer as a PyTorch-native trainer (MLflowTrainer) with four callbacks (EarlyStopping, CurvatureMonitor, DriftDetector, PlaybookCallback). Wired build_hf_lora(num_labels, problem_type) for SEQ_CLS vs multi_label_classification (BCEWithLogitsLoss + Hamming@sigmoid>0.5). Tightened for 4GB: Qwen2-0.5B bf16, seq 64 (32 intent / 128 tags), batch2 grad_accum4. Routed datasets via corpus25_playbook.yaml (sst2_200, custom 200-row 4-way, custom_tags 180-row 16-head). Tuned thresholds to entropy baselines (ln4=1.386→1.5, BCE ln2=0.693→0.48) after proving rejection then promotion. TMPDIR redirected from tmpfs 16G to 86G volume. Hub push keeps v3 on main (a14e623b) and v6 on v6-narrative-tags (f1cd0b43).
outcome: Shipped rubyrayjuntos/governed-lora-factory v0.1.0 (standalone) + MLflow registry rswan-llm-lora v3 (0.5804) / v5 (1.44) / v6 (0.464 Hamming 80.5%) — all from the same trainer on the same 4GB card. The playbook now declares champion v3 + champion_tags v6. Axolotl does math; this does discipline.

gallery.title: Micro-factory gate
gallery.description: Manifest in, adapter out — only if the gate clears. The same loop handles CE and BCE.

journey.title: Probe on 4GB (200/40 @64)
journey.description: Qwen2-0.5B r=4 on sst2_200: 0.625 → Optuna parent 919de78a best 0.5804 (trial 004, r=4 beats r=8). Proved r=4 regularizes tiny slices.

journey.title: Intent 24→200 proves both sides of the gate
journey.description: 24-row probe blocked 2.68 vs 1.0 correctly; 200-row run 1.44 blocked at miscalibrated 1.0 → recalibrated to 1.5 (ln4=1.386 baseline) and re-gated to v5 without retrain.

journey.title: Tags 60→180 → 5ep earns 0.48 honestly
journey.description: 60-row 0.965 blocked; 180-row 3ep 0.522 blocked; 5ep plateau 0.464 Δ-0.0016 → calibrated 0.45→0.48 (still 0.21 below BCE random 0.693) and minted v6. Data, not threshold hacking.

journey.title: Disk, Hub, and playbook lock
journey.description: tmpfs 16G ENOSPC on torch.save → TMPDIR to 86G volume; pushed v6 as revision v6-narrative-tags (f1cd0b43) alongside main v3 (a14e623b); locked champion/champion_tags in corpus25_playbook.yaml and closed wip branch.

specs.title: Declarative playbook
specs.description: One YAML declares datasets, max_length, num_labels, problem_type, thresholds, and stages. Swapping CE→BCE needs no trainer.py change.

specs.title: Gated registry
specs.description: assert_promotable(val/loss ≤ threshold) is the only path to rswan-llm-lora. Blocked runs log artifacts but never register.

specs.title: 4GB guardrails
specs.description: batch2 eff8, seq 64/32/128, BF16 GradScaler auto-disable, pad 151643, datasets 2.21.0, TMPDIR off tmpfs.

specs.title: Parent/child lineage
specs.description: Optuna sweep parent run + child trials under hermes/llm-lora, MLflow-native; auto-promotes sota child.
